models.name: Clay v1 Base
models.paper_note: Clay v1 Base encoder (92.1M parameters). TerraTorch's timm_clay_v1_base loads made-with-clay/Clay-legacy, v1/clay-v1-base.ckpt. Canonical harness selectors are terratorch/clay_v1 and terratorch/clay_v1_cls. Historical v1_5_base result IDs identify this same v1 checkpoint. The v1.5 documentation describes a 311M encoder and a 632M pretraining model including decoder and teacher; it is a different checkpoint.
